jobs.title: Part-Time & Supply SEN Teaching Assistant
jobs.description:
Job Description

Part-Time & Supply SEN Teaching Assistant

Location: Wakefield

Start Date: September 2026

Hours: Flexible Part-Time & Supply Opportunities Available

Salary: Competitive daily rate / hourly rate dependent on experience

We are currently seeking reliable, enthusiastic and compassionate SEN Teaching Assistants to provide part-time and supply support within a specialist educational setting in Wakefield from September.

The provision supports children and young people with a range of Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND), including Autism Spectrum Condition (ASC), communication and interaction difficulties, moderate to severe learning difficulties, sensory needs, and social, emotional and mental health (SEMH) needs.

This is an excellent opportunity for individuals looking for flexible work while making a genuine difference to the lives of pupils who require additional support to access education and achieve their potential.

The Role

As a Supply SEN Teaching Assistant, you will:

  • Provide classroom, small group and 1:1 support to pupils with SEND.
  • Assist teaching staff in delivering engaging learning activities.
  • Support pupils' communication, emotional regulation and social development.
  • Promote positive behaviour and engagement in learning.
  • Adapt to different classes and age groups as required.
  • Help create a safe, nurturing and inclusive learning environment.
  • Support pupils with personal care where necessary.

Requirements

We are looking for candidates who:

  • Have previous experience supporting children or young people with SEND.
  • Ideally have experience working within a specialist SEND school or alternative provision.
  • Have knowledge of autism, communication needs and learning difficulties.
  • Are caring, patient and resilient.
  • Can build strong professional relationships with pupils and staff.
  • Are flexible and comfortable working in different classroom settings.
  • Hold an enhanced DBS on the Update Service or be willing to obtain one.

Why Apply ?

  • Flexible working patterns to suit your availability.
  • Opportunity to gain experience within a specialist SEND setting.
  • Supportive and welcoming staff team.
  • Rewarding work that has a real impact on pupils' lives.
  • Ongoing opportunities throughout the academic year.

Whether you're an experienced SEN Teaching Assistant, a support worker with relevant experience, or someone looking to build a career within specialist education, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to secure flexible SEN support work for September.

jobs.title: Part Time Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

Part Time Marketing Manager
Location: Knaresborough
Salary: £25 - £35 per hour
Hours: Part-time, 22-30 hours per week
Working Pattern: Flexible - our client is happy to discuss hours and working patterns around the successful candidate

Looking for a Marketing Manager role that works around you?

We're working with an established organisation that is looking for a Part Time Marketing Manager to take ownership of its marketing and communications activity.

This is a genuinely flexible opportunity. While the initial requirement is around 22-30 hours per week, our client is open to discussing different hours and working arrangements for the right person.

So, whether you're looking to balance work around family commitments, another responsibility, a portfolio career or simply want a better work life balance, this could offer the flexibility you've been looking for without compromising on the level of responsibility or variety in the role.

You'll have real ownership of the marketing function, working closely with senior colleagues to shape strategy and deliver activity across digital marketing, content, social media, campaigns, PR, brand, website, advertising and events. You'll also provide direction to a Marketing Executive and work with external agencies and creative partners.

Most importantly, our client is looking for someone who is passionate about what they do and wants to use their marketing skills to create something genuinely positive for people.

What will you be responsible for?

  • Taking ownership of the overall marketing strategy and activity
  • Developing and delivering engaging campaigns across digital and offline channels
  • Creating and overseeing content across social media, email, website and other communications
  • Developing the organisation's brand presence and ensuring consistency across all activity
  • Leading social media planning and using performance data to improve engagement
  • Overseeing website content, SEO and digital performance
  • Supporting digital advertising and promotional campaigns
  • Developing PR and communications activity
  • Planning marketing activity around events and key organisational initiatives
  • Monitoring campaign performance and using insight to shape future activity
  • Managing the marketing budget and ensuring activity provides value
  • Working with external agencies, designers and creative partners
  • Providing guidance and support to the Marketing Executive
  • Identifying new opportunities, ideas and improvements across the marketing function

What are we looking for?
You'll ideally already have experience at Marketing Manager, Marketing & Communications Manager, Digital Marketing Manager, Senior Marketing Executive or Marketing Lead level.

We're looking for someone who can think strategically but isn't afraid to get stuck in. You'll be comfortable taking ownership, developing ideas and turning them into effective marketing activity.

You'll ideally have:

  • Previous experience in a broad marketing role
  • Experience developing and delivering marketing campaigns
  • Strong digital marketing, content and social media experience
  • Excellent written communication and copywriting skills
  • A good understanding of website, SEO, email and marketing analytics
  • Experience using data to measure performance and improve results
  • Strong organisation and project management skills
  • Experience working with agencies, freelancers or external suppliers
  • Ideally, experience of supporting or managing a junior marketing colleague
  • A creative approach with excellent attention to detail
  • The confidence to contribute ideas and influence others
  • A proactive, positive approach and genuine enthusiasm for the organisation's purpose

What's on offer?

  • £25 - £35 per hour
  • Approximately 22-30 hours per week
  • Flexible hours - our client is willing to work around the successful candidate
  • Other hours and working patterns may be considered for the right person
  • Genuine ownership of the marketing function
  • A varied role covering digital, content, campaigns, PR, brand, website and events
  • The opportunity to shape and develop the organisation's marketing approach
  • Responsibility for supporting a Marketing Executive
  • A collaborative environment where ideas and creativity are encouraged
  • The opportunity to use your marketing expertise for something that genuinely makes a positive difference to people

Want senior level responsibility without the full time hours?
If you're an experienced marketer looking for a role where you can make an impact, have genuine ownership and still have the flexibility to fit work around your life, this could be an excellent opportunity.

Our client is genuinely open minded about hours and working arrangements, so if you have the right experience and passion but need something outside the traditional full time model, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact Impression Recruitment for a confidential conversation about the opportunity.

Our Guarantee

If we have not contacted you within 5 working days of your application, please understand that the CV received, and the information provided does not meet the requirements of the current vacancy. However, we will consider all applications for any available opportunity, present or future, and proactively contact you should we deem there to be a suitable match.

jobs.title: Part Time Accounts Assistant
jobs.description:
Job Description

Michael Page are actively working with a long standing client who are looking for a Part Time Accounts Assistant to join their team in South Leeds on a permanent basis. My client is looking for a proactive, and hands on individual that has experience working on both Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Credit Control functions.

Client Details

Michael Page are actively working with a long standing client who are looking for a Part Time Accounts Assistant to join their team in South Leeds on a permanent basis. My client is looking for a proactive, and hands on individual that has experience working on both Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Credit Control functions. This is a perfect opportunity for a candidate looking for a flexible, 30 hours per week Accounts role that can be tailored to your routine. My client is a well known business in their industry, known for their top quality working culture.

Description

  • Process invoices and ensure accurate record-keeping.
  • Managing processes for both purchase and sales ledger
  • Reconcile accounts and resolve any discrepancies.
  • Assist with preparing financial reports and statements.
  • Maintain up-to-date and accurate financial records.
  • Support with credit control tasks
  • Support the finance team with administrative tasks as needed.
  • Communicate with other departments regarding financial queries.
  • Ensure compliance with financial regulations and company policies.
  • Provide support during audits and financial reviews.

Profile

A successful Part Time Accounts Assistant should have:

  • Experience in an accounts assistant, finance assistant role is essential
  • Wanting 30 hours a week split over 4 or 5 days.
  • Familiarity with financial software and systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
  • Ability to manage time effectively and meet deadlines.
  • Good communication skills to liaise with colleagues and external parties.
  • A proactive approach to problem-solving

Job Offer

  • Salary ranging from £30,000-£32,000 FTE
  • Hybrid working - 1 or 2 days onsite, and the rest at home.
  • 25-30 hours a week split over 4-5 days
  • Flexible working hours to suit your routine
  • Permanent position
  • Free parking onsite
  • Opportunity to be part of a high performing finance team known for their positive working culture

If you're interested in this role, apply now.
